rules.note: Mass in Honour of St Joseph

info.adoration: Adoration Room open Mon-Fri 7.00am-9.00pm, Sat 9.30am-7.00pm, Sun 8.00am-7.00pm and public holidays 8.00am-4.00pm. Holy Hour: first Friday 8pm in the Main Church (unless otherwise stated). Holy Hour for Vocations: third Thursday 8pm in the
info.confession: 15 minutes before all weekend Masses, in the Reconciliation Rooms in the Church.
devotions: Divine Mercy: every Friday 8pm (except the first Friday), Chapel of St Joseph
Garden Rosary: first Saturday after the 5.30pm Mass
Grotto Rosary: every 13th of the month after the 6.30pm Mass (weekdays only)
Blessing of Expectant Mothers: every fourth Sunday of the month
good_to_know: Columbarium, Rosary Garden and Stations of the Cross are open daily 8.00am to 8.00pm.
Media Centre (bookshop): Sat 4.30pm-7.00pm, Sun 8.30am-1.00pm; also every 2nd Sunday 5.30pm-7.00pm.

events.title: Small Catholic Communities dinner
events.text: Come together with the Small Catholic Community in your neighbourhood for dinner with our parish priests on Saturday 17 Oct after the sunset Mass. All parishioners are welcome; register at tinyurl.com/SCCGM2026 so a simple dinner can be provided.

events.title: Mysteries of the Rosary: The Joyful Mysteries
events.text: A video series on the Joyful Mysteries, in person and online via Zoom, every Tuesday night or Wednesday morning from 20 Oct. Join the Faith & Bible Reflections WhatsApp Community at tinyurl.com/SJCBTFAB.

events.title: World Youth Day Car Wash Fundraiser
events.text: Car wash on 24 and 25 Oct in support of our youths travelling to Seoul for World Youth Day. Please do support them.

events.title: PIETA
events.text: PIETA gathering on Tuesday 27 Oct at 7.30pm.

events.title: Prayer thru Music
events.text: An evening of prayer through music on Friday 30 Oct at 8pm.

events.title: All Saints Day Fair
events.text: Parents, families and parishioners are invited to the All Saints Day Fair at the Parish Community Hall on 31 Oct-1 Nov, where children and youth from the catechetical sessions bring the stories of the saints to life. Admission is open to all.

events.title: Formed to Flourish
events.text: Young adults in their 20s and 30s are invited to a casual, welcoming space to meet the Catholic community, make new friends and share in fellowship, on Saturday 31 Oct at 3pm.

events.title: Treasure #18 Retreat for Young Working Adults
events.text: A stay-in Catholic Encounter Retreat for young working adults aged 21-35, from Friday 6 Nov to Monday 9 Nov.

events.title: Parish Recollection
events.text: A day with the Singapore Archdiocesan Catholic Charismatic Renewal (SACCRE) on discovering how God calls us to holiness where we are; free lunch and refreshments provided. Register by 2 November at tinyurl.com/SJCBTDoR2026.

events.title: Beginning Experience
events.text: A weekend programme from 13 to 15 Nov.

events.title: Emmanuel
events.text: A morning of reflection for those approaching retirement or in their golden years, on Friday 13 Nov at 10am, on living this stage of life with confidence and purpose.

events.title: Sec 4/5 Outreach
events.text: Graduating from secondary school this year? Join OYP for a time of prayer with the Lord and to meet fellow Sec 4 & 5 students on Saturday 21 Nov.
